messages:
ana: Quick sync — APAC Regional Ecosystem Roundtable with CloudCo + EdgeSys next Wed 9am SGT. Need speaker confirmations, demo kit status, and swag handoff plan.

matt: Confirmed slot on our side. Can CloudCo do a 10min platform overview + 15min joint live Q&A?

kevin (CloudCo): Yep, 10 + 15 works. Kevin will present an integration case study. Need a 5 minute slot for CP marketplace listing notes.

mei (EdgeSys): We can demo an on-prem hardware inference flow. Will need GPU availability and network passthrough for the live demo.

ana: @matt @sarah re: run-of-show — suggest: 1) intros (3m) 2) CloudCo overview (10m) 3) EdgeSys live demo (12m) 4) Redwood short roadmap + marketplace note (6m) 5) joint Q&A (15m) 6) CTA + swag giveaway (4m). Thoughts? :thumbsup:

sarah: LGTM. Action items: collect speaker slides + headshots by Monday EOD, AV checklist by Tuesday noon, and swag shipping confirmation by Tues EOD.

jin: AV checklist: HDMI passthrough + fallback video (screen share fallback to prerecorded) + 2x mics. I'll reserve a backup GPU node in staging for the demo (tag: roundtable-staging).

mei (EdgeSys): Good call on prerecorded backup. We'll prepare a 3min recorded demo in case network blocks live access. Also sending hardware ETA to @sarah now.

lina: Swag ops — we have 200 partner packs. Can we confirm who gets physical packs vs digital promo codes? Partner ask: 3 priority customers for in-person drop.

kevin (CloudCo): CloudCo will take 50 physical packs for APAC partners. We need tracking numbers and a contact at Redwood ops to coordinate customs forms.

ana: @lina I'll share customs contact: sara-ops@redwood.ai. Please include item values and HTS codes. Also tag shipment with event code: RWINF-APAC-2026.

matt: Rehearsal: Wed prior at 8am SGT (45min). Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/roundtable-rehearsal. Please be on time.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit slide deck to events@redwood.ai by 2026-03-02 17:00 PT to meet assets deadline.

sarah: Marketplace note: @kevin can you send the one-paragraph copy for the CloudCo listing so we can include the link in the closing CTA? Need by Monday.

jin: For the live demo, config snippet we'll use (for ops):
```
ssh -i demo-key.pem ubuntu@roundtable-staging
docker run --gpus all redwood/edge-demo:latest --model gpt-4-mini --port 8080
```
If live fails, play prerecorded mp4 stored at s3://redwood-roundtable/backups/edgesys-demo.mp4

lina: Swag tracking: shipping label created (AWB: RWINFAPAC123456). ETA to Singapore customs Thu evening. I'll update channel when cleared.

kevin (CloudCo): Also sending speaker bios + headshot now. Attaching slides shortly.

ana: Great. Final checklist recap: slides+headshots by Mon EOD, rehearsal Wed 8am SGT, AV + staging reserved (jin), swag shipping tracked (lina), marketplace blurbs (kevin), prerecorded backup ready (mei). Thanks everyone — will post run-of-show draft today. :sparkles:
